ŠK Slovan Bratislava is a professional football club based in Bratislava, Slovakia, that competes in the Slovak First Football League. Founded as I. ČSŠK Bratislava in 1919, the club adopted its current name in 1953. Slovan is the most successful football club in Slovakia, having won the most league and cup titles in the country.
